units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 6">Midr. Till. to Ps. VI</cite>, end <he>אחרים מקבלים אנ׳ וכ׳</he> (corr. <he>אכ׳</he>) others receive the petition presented to him <he>אני איני מבקש אלא אנסיומין שלי</he> (corr. acc., insert <he>שאתה תקבל</he>) I only ask that thou mayest receive my petition thyself.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 102:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. CII</cite> <he>אל תתן א׳ שלי בתוכה</he> (read <he>שלו</he>); [the entire passage is obscure and seems out of place].
